summary: Nathaniel DeWitt Garson is a scholar in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He earned his PhD at the University of Virginia, studying under doctoral supervisor Jeffrey Hopkins, and also studied under traditional teacher Khenpo Namdrol.

Nathaniel Wallich (1786–1854) studied at the University of Aberdeen (MD) and University of Copenhagen. He served as Superintendent of the new museum at The Asiatic Society, Superintendent of the Indian Botanic Garden (1817–1846), and Vice-President of the Linnean Society.

Nathmal Tatia (1923–2003) was a scholar of Indology, philosophy, and religious studies. He earned a Doctor of Literature at the University of Calcutta under Satkari Mookerjee, studied under Sukhlal Sanghvi, and served as Director of Jain Vishva Bharati Institute.
Navaneethakrishnan S is an Indologist who completed a Master of Philosophy at the University of Sri Lanka. In 2021, he held a post as Senior Lecturer at the University of Jaffna.
Navina Lamminger is a scholar in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD from the University of Munich, where she studied under doctoral supervisor Franz-Karl Ehrhard.

Nawang Tsering Shakspo (born 1948) works in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under doctoral supervisor Lal Mani Joshi and served as a Lecturer at the Central Institute of Buddhist Studies (attested 1985).
Nazir Ahmad Dehlvi (1831–1912) was an Indology scholar who studied at the University of Delhi under Mamluk Ali Nanautawi (circa 1845–1853). He later taught Ghulam Yazdani.
Neal Donner is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Sinology. He studied at the University of British Columbia under Leon Hurvitz (attested 1976).
Neelima Mundayar is a scholar in religious studies and Indology. She is a PhD student at the University of Edinburgh studying under doctoral supervisor Wilfried Swenden (attested 2026).

Nenghai Shi (1886–1967) worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at Peking University, founded the Shaocheng Society of Buddhist Studies (1917), and served as vice-president of the Buddhist Association of China (1953–1966).

Nepal Das specializes in Indology and philosophy. He studied at Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda Educational and Research Institute (BA and MA) and National Sanskrit University (MPhil and PhD), and was appointed Assistant Professor at Central Sanskrit University in 2020.
Newton Mohun Dutt worked in Indology and served as Curator of Libraries for Baroda State and the Central Library of Vadodara from circa 1914 to 1934.

Ng-Fung Yuen specializes in Buddhist studies and religious studies. Yuen earned a Doctor of Philosophy at the University of the West under doctoral supervisor Kottegoda S. Warnasuriya (attested 2009).
Ngakchang Gönpo Tsé Ten studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche and Dudjom Rinpoche.

Ngan-che Chan works in Buddhist studies. Chan studied at the University of Hong Kong (PhD), University of Leeds, and The Chinese University of Hong Kong, where Chan served as Assistant Professor in 2023.
Ngawang Jorden is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He has held a post at Sakya College and served as director of the International Buddhist Academy.
Ngawang Lek Shé Gyatso studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Dodrupchen Rinpoche, and Trulshik Rinpoche.

Ngawang Nyima was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under the 13th Dalai Lama, the 14th Dalai Lama, and Trijang Rinpoche, and taught Dezhung Rinpoche Kunga Tenpai Nyima, Thubten Jigme Norbu, and Dagpo Rinpoche.
Ngawang Sherpa is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He earned a PhD in Buddhist studies at Florida State University in 2022 and held an appointment in Religion there that same year.

Ngorpa Pönlob Lo Ter Wangpo studied under Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye, Shechen Gyaltsab, and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso. He taught Shenphen Nangwa and Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö.
